correctness.rationale: Invertible derivative maps every exactly-one length-two duplication to insertion of two derivative zeros. Invariant zero-run parity classes decompose the graph, and shared descendant iff compositions have L1 distance 2. The exact finite sum over independence numbers is proved in RESULT.md. Standalone exhaustive maximum-clique with valid proper-coloring branch bound checks all 56 graph types through maximum 126 vertices; explicitly assembled codes pass direct descendant disjointness. Independent direct-channel exhaustive maximum-clique checks n=3..9.
